title: Depress an autofolder feed table and load a squared newsletter stack to the retarder stop
instruction: Load this newsletter stack into the folder so it is ready to feed.
context: In high-volume office mailrooms, print shops, church and school administrative offices, and billing departments, friction-feed desktop paper folders such as the Martin Yale 1501X AutoFolder (https://www.martinyale.com/product/1501x-paper-folder/, machine net weight 31 lb / 14.1 kg) fold up to 150 sheets of 20 lb bond paper at a time. Following the Martin Yale 1501X operation manual (paraphrased here, not quoted), the operator puts the neat stack on the tray, presses the spring-raised feed table down, slides the stack between the side guides until its front edge meets the retarder frame, and lets the table rise so the stack presses against the rubber feed wheel. It takes two hands because the table springs back up when released: one hand keeps it down while the other slides the stack. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (BLS OEWS May 2024), this routine mailroom and document-preparation workflow spans Office Clerks, General (SOC 43-9061, 2,487,670 U.S. workers, https://www.bls.gov/oes/current/oes439061.htm) and Secretaries and Administrative Assistants, Except Legal, Medical, and Executive (SOC 43-6014, 1,722,060 U.S. workers, https://www.bls.gov/oes/current/oes436014.htm).
setup: On the station table: a desktop friction-feed paper folder feed-table, retarder-frame, and overhead rubber feed-wheel assembly (`autofolder_housing`, 252 mm wide along x by 380 mm long along y by 176 mm tall, 14.1 kg / 31 lb powder-coated steel frame on non-skid rubber feet at x = 0.255 m, y = +0.010 m, matching the Martin Yale 1501X net weight per https://www.martinyale.com/product/1501x-paper-folder/) with fixed side paper guides spaced 223 mm apart along x (3.5 mm clearance per side for 216 mm letter width), an overhead 58 mm diameter rubber feed wheel at y = +0.092 m, and a retarder stop at y = +0.130 m. Hinged on the housing at (0.255, -0.036, TOP + 0.112) m is the spring-elevated feed table (`feed_table`, sheet steel, 210 x 226 x 28 mm, 0.240 kg, `rx.Revolute` about X with constant upward spring stiffness 0.055 N*m/deg toward +13.0 deg, upper rest stop 0.0 deg where the empty nip gap under the feed wheel is 7.4..8.9 mm, and rated bottom stop -16.5 deg). Resting on the right-hand entry staging apron at (0.255, -0.1060, TOP + 0.124) m is a squared half-letter (statement-size) newsletter stack (`newsletter_packet`, 216 x 140 x 20 mm, 0.540 kg).
scoring: 1.0 when `autofolder_housing` is on the table (moved <= 15 mm, tilt <= 8 deg), `newsletter_packet` has its leading edge within 5 mm of the retarder stop (`<= 0.005 m`), lateral offset `<= 6 mm`, deck gap `<= 4 mm`, yaw `<= 5 deg`, and tilt relative to the feed table `<= 4 deg`, `feed_table` is released and clamping the stack against the overhead feed wheel (`-7.5` to `-3.5 deg`, wheel nip gap `<= 2.5 mm`), both grippers are at least 30 mm clear of all task objects, and all parts are at rest for 1.0 s. 0.5 when the folder is stable and either the stack is loaded and clamped while a gripper is still within 30 mm, or the feed table has been depressed (`<= -12 deg`) and the stack slid within 15 mm of the retarder stop (`yaw <= 5 deg`) before releasing the table. 0.0 otherwise or on any latched fault (`folder_moved` > 15 mm, `packet_dropped` descending > 50 mm while neither gripper touches it, or `table_pushed_past_stop` < -16.5 deg).
fidelity: Approximated: the stack is one rigid 20 mm, 0.54 kg block, thicker and heavier than 150 sheets of 20 lb bond (~15 mm, 0.34 kg); the 7.4-8.9 mm empty gap under the wheel is below both, so the table must be held down either way. Only the infeed end of the housing is modelled (252 x 380 x 176 mm) at the whole machine's 14.1 kg. Wheel and table are box-collider unions on a passive spring hinge. Real: 14.1 kg mass (1501X spec), 223 mm guide spacing, 58 mm wheel, contact-only blocking and clamping.
reset_notes: Return `autofolder_housing` to `(0.255, +0.010, TOP + 0.088)` m on the table, let `feed_table` return to its `0.0 deg` upper rest stop under its passive spring, and place `newsletter_packet` flat on the right-hand entry staging apron at `(0.255, -0.1060, TOP + 0.124)` m.
